experiment_phases.purpose: fix hypotheses, pricing and decision thresholds
discover value, misunderstanding and reaction to provisional prices
actual demand, reliable fulfillment, actual contribution
price differentiation beyond initial one-price pilot

hypotheses.question: Free vs paid difference understood without pressure
Evidence-bounded timeline and voluntary reading are valued
Which provision/assurances make each provisional price feel reasonable
Can approved real orders be fulfilled safely on time
hypotheses.primary_evidence: verified real delivery history after G2

hypotheses.question: Are MK04 labor and variable costs feasible
hypotheses.primary_evidence: actual minutes and transaction expenses after G2

hypotheses.question: Do buyers actually pay under clear terms
hypotheses.primary_evidence: server-confirmed paid order events after G2

EXP1.display_notice: 開発中・見本は架空・販売未承認。購入・予約・支払い・連絡先登録はできません。
questions: What do you think is delivered?
What differs from the free content?

G2_start_conditions.evidence_required: M06 N01 N05 independent calendar eligibility and year-source validation
N05 review of story and non-fabricated personal events
actual seller, law, price, final confirmation, payment, refund, support
sensitive data protection, PDF authorization, idempotent transaction and incident recovery
all mandatory SD01-SD22 actual sandbox and human acceptance evidence
consented qualitative study and resolved severe findings
named responsible approval linked to exact build and customer-facing terms
authoritative order / refund aggregates and disclosure review

research_kpis.name: concept_understanding
research_kpis.definition: MK10 B01/B04/B06 plus observed O06-O08 with actual n and NA/SKIP

research_kpis.name: decision_blockers
research_kpis.definition: issues and missing information grouped with unidentifiable summaries

research_kpis.name: hypothetical_price_reaction
research_kpis.definition: counts per price 1980/2980/3980 and nonleading reasons; not actual orders

research_kpis.name: coercion_or_misrepresentation
research_kpis.definition: P0-P3 coded issues on promises, validity, pressure

research_kpis.name: appeal_of_story
research_kpis.definition: MK10 B07 distribution and anonymized reasons

sales_kpis.name: checkout_start_events
sales_kpis.definition: MK08 checkout_start; count, not unique people

sales_kpis.name: confirmed_paid_orders
sales_kpis.definition: Payment verified server-side unique successful orders

sales_kpis.name: net_receipts
sales_kpis.definition: verified paid total - verified refunds, not accounting profit

sales_kpis.name: actual_fulfillment_labor
sales_kpis.definition: production, QA, revisions and support time including failures

sales_kpis.name: actual_contribution
sales_kpis.definition: actual net receipts less actual variable costs and processing, if measured

sales_kpis.name: on_time_delivery
sales_kpis.definition: successfully accessible private PDFs by promised deadline / valid fulfillment orders

sales_kpis.name: support_and_reissue
sales_kpis.definition: aggregate support cases without birth data and notes in analytics

sales_kpis.name: severe_incidents
sales_kpis.definition: P0/P1, wrong calendar, leak, duplicate bill, fraudulent payment

sales_kpis.name: reference_event_ratio
sales_kpis.definition: verified order count / product_view and / checkout_start events, NOT person CVR

sales_kpis.name: postpurchase_optional_review
sales_kpis.definition: voluntary perception of clarity, autonomy, readability, fulfillment

stop_conditions.trigger: missing G2 or calendar ineligibility or unsupported birth charged
unsubstantiated promise, fake testimonial, fake deadline or comparative price
stop_conditions.action: pause ads and checkout, legal re-review

stop_conditions.trigger: research or birth data collected without consent; file access leak
stop_conditions.action: stop data, protect individuals, statutory reporting evaluation

stop_conditions.trigger: double charge, invalid webhook, refund or fulfillment failure
stop_conditions.action: pause checkout and affected processing, customer remedy

stop_conditions.trigger: serious distress, fictional actual life assertions, manipulation
stop_conditions.action: halt content, review, correct and remedy

stop_conditions.trigger: insufficient editing QA support capacity or delivery deadline risk
stop_conditions.action: pause new orders, fulfill existing commitments

stop_conditions.trigger: actual expenses cross approved budget or sustained nonpositive contribution

stop_conditions.action: pause expansion and inference, investigate without PII overcollection

decision_outcomes.meaning: G2 incomplete or EXP1 research without approval
critical legal safety financial or fulfillment incident
decision_outcomes.next: remediate all affected customers and re-review

decision_outcomes.meaning: small n, missing data, insufficient differentiation, sampling bias
decision_outcomes.next: refine and collect only with proper separate approval

decision_outcomes.meaning: approved safe on-time pilot delivery evidence exists
decision_outcomes.next: document initial capability not demand validation

decision_outcomes.meaning: actual costs exceed budget or contribution no longer positive
safe fulfillment, measured actual costs and owner approves planning next round

acceptance_tests.title: MK01-MK10の整合
acceptance_tests.expected: Free/paid separation, P-A hypothesis and all product limitations retained

acceptance_tests.title: EXP1が非取引である
acceptance_tests.expected: Fictional sample + no sales/no booking/no payment/no checkout + development notice

acceptance_tests.title: 価格順序・非誘導
acceptance_tests.expected: 1980/2980/3980 provisional price prompts balanced and reasons elicited

acceptance_tests.title: 参加同意・撤回
acceptance_tests.expected: MK10 consent and restricted research records available before recruitment

acceptance_tests.title: 暦G2-C
acceptance_tests.expected: Personal calendar, year anchoring, boundary and unsupported inputs validated

acceptance_tests.title: 物語G2-S
acceptance_tests.expected: No fabricated personal events, no post-hoc modification of candidate years, human QA

acceptance_tests.title: 法務G2-L
acceptance_tests.expected: Legitimate seller, full price, returns, delivery term, correction on final confirmation

acceptance_tests.title: データG2-D
acceptance_tests.expected: Verified payments, no cross-customer PDFs, encrypted sensitive data and incident recovery

acceptance_tests.title: E2E・イベント
acceptance_tests.expected: MK09 SD01-22 and server-sourced purchase refund counts reconciled

acceptance_tests.title: 単一価格・供給上限
acceptance_tests.expected: Approved one-price pilot, maximum approved orders and first-three canary hold

acceptance_tests.title: 実原価の更新
acceptance_tests.expected: Actual labor, fees, refunds and fulfillment measured rather than MK04 assumptions

acceptance_tests.title: 分母・欠測
acceptance_tests.expected: MK08 ratios not represented as unique buyers; NA remains NA

acceptance_tests.title: 停止・復旧
acceptance_tests.expected: All eight stop cases exercise halt new order, protect current clients, and require approval

acceptance_tests.title: 結果の再現
acceptance_tests.expected: Experiment version, source-of-truth orders, costs and results with audit evidence

acceptance_tests.title: 実売未承認
acceptance_tests.expected: No booking, no sales, no payment, no public acquisition; G1/G2 NO_GO

acceptance_tests.title: 引継ぎ
acceptance_tests.expected: MK12 deferred expansion with release dependencies and owner documented
